description: OpenBMB tokenizer-free TTS model supporting 30 languages and 9 Chinese dialects, with 48 kHz output, natural-language voice design, controllable short-reference voice cloning, and expressive style guidance.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated audio tokens. Zero resolves to model max_length; requires min_tokens <= resolved max_tokens <= model limit.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Flow sampling steps. Must be positive.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Must be nonnegative.

request.name: retry_badcase
request.description: Retry detected bad generations. Offline only; streaming requires false.

request.name: retry_badcase_max_times
request.description: Total attempts including the initial attempt, not extra retries; must be positive.

request.name: retry_badcase_ratio_threshold
request.description: Bad-case audio/text length ratio threshold. Must be positive.

request.name: stream_chunk_policy
request.description: Streaming decoder cadence: grow emits one patch first, then doubles toward stream_frames_per_event; fixed uses the configured size. Ignored offline.

request.name: stream_frames_per_event
request.description: Maximum generated latent patches per streaming decoder event. Set to 1 for one-patch emission. Ignored offline.

request.name: stream_left_context
request.description: Previous patches decoded as streaming left context.

request.name: prompt_text
request.description: Transcript for continuation prompt audio, distinct from the base voice reference.

request.name: chunk_strategy
request.description: Long-form continuation or independent generation per chunk. Offline only.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Framework long-form text chunk size. Offline only.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking mode. Offline only.

session.name: audiovae_tile_frames
session.description: Opt-in causal AudioVAE tiling. Maximum new latent frames per tile; zero preserves full decoding.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Opt-in packed attention and MLP projections. May change numerical results; off preserves standard execution.

session.name: lora
session.description: Native LoRA directory or checkpoint file with adjacent lora_config.json; merged into generator weights at session creation.

session.name: lora_scale
session.description: Multiplier for the adapter's configured alpha/r scaling; default 1.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Language-model weight storage; does not override AudioVAE storage.

session.name: audiovae_weight_type
session.description: AudioVAE weight storage; defaults independently to native, not the shared weight_type.

session.name: prompt_cache_slots
session.description: Cached encoded prompt slots; zero disables reuse.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Context or graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: text_embedding_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Text embedding host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: lm_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: LM step host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: projection_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Projection host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: local_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Local encoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: dit_graph_arena_mb
session.description: DiT estimator host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: audiovae_weight_context_mb
session.description: Context or graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: audiovae_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AudioVAE decoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: audiovae_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AudioVAE encoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: audiovae_latent_capacity
session.description: Optional decoder graph reservation in latent frames, reused by shorter requests and doubled when exceeded; omitted builds the graph at each request's own frame count.

session.name: exec_plan
session.description: JSON component execution plans. audiovae: impl=default/ggml; backend must match the session; no artifacts. params.threads is a nonnegative int: positive values require a CPU session and enable a dedicated AudioVAE backend with streaming decode overlap; also controls offline decoding and prompt encoding threads. Omitted/0 shares the session backend.

session.name: audiovae_encoder_sample_capacity
session.description: Reserved encoder sample capacity.
